limits: No whole E07/QG01, global gate/debt/Knip/Node22/CI/model/build/native acceptance. No install/build/model/native/shared config/task/spec/status/git/product edits performed; one accidental broad test execution is expressly documented as a harness failure.
The historical 91-error baseline is the frozen implementation comparison, independently aligned with actual E07 entry and before-copy hashes; the historical lint was not rerun in a new mirror.
Coverage is all Slice B changed sites and surrounding contracts plus all four new test files; this is not a fresh whole-body audit of untouched code in every large owner.
58 surviving warnings are unchanged per-file rule/message multiplicity. They are review signals only here and no debt allowance is accepted.

Grainient runtime proof uses actual component callbacks and installed OGL Program with instrumented React hooks/WebGL/browser surfaces in Node. It proves object/callback lifecycle equivalence, not React DOM mounting, real GPU pixels, native visibility scheduling or visual fidelity.
The handwritten supplemental fixtures are local sidecar evidence, not permanent tests or global quality configuration.
Compiler/test execution is local machine Node24.11.0 with explicit machine pnpm10.15.0. Locked clean Node22 and GitHub Linux CI remain main/gate work.

Unchanged historical JSON casts and malformed noncanonical persisted labels outside repaired sites are not claimed as hardened. Canonical delivery/image labels are string data; raw object/array stringification is not a compatibility promise.
